question: Which upstream capacity feed produced quote Q-884's incorrect H100 availability?
initial_context: Quote Q-884 reported 512 available H100s, while reconciliation established that only 128 were available.

record-a.content: A broker wrote that Q-884 probably came from feed-north. The note says this attribution was copied from a forwarded message and was not checked against ingestion records.

record-b.content: Signed receipt IR-441 maps payload hash 7c91 to upstream source feed-west. The receipt does not contain a desk quote ID.

record-c.content: The generated summary attributes Q-884 to feed-north. Its provenance field names Record A as its only source; no independent receipt or ledger was consulted.

record-d.content: The immutable desk ledger maps Q-884 to stored payload hash 7c91 and records the 512-to-128 reconciliation mismatch. The ledger does not name the upstream feed.
